raw_result.pairwise_analysis: B ranks first because it delivers all four requested components — characterization tests, a reasoned seam extraction order, incremental strangler steps, and module boundaries — with explicit per-commit verification. E is technically superior on architecture (pure-logic-first seam order) and correctness (asserting domain state over raw SQL), but it truncates before the strangler steps.
